description:
Remote worldwide · Some overlap with US Eastern

About the role

Our creator program went from 300K to over 1.5M views in its first month. Our next target is 10M+.

AnswerThis helps researchers find, understand, and work with scientific evidence. Our creators are students and PhDs making short-form videos about research, and we’re hiring someone to run that program day to day.

You’ll work directly with Ryan, our cofounder, across creator sourcing, onboarding, content review, and delivery. Ryan will initially own creative strategy and weekly briefs. You’ll make sure creators have what they need and keep the program running reliably.

What you’ll do

  • Keep the creator pipeline full through prospect research, Instagram DMs, and email.

  • Maintain clean prospect lists and keep our creator-sourcing tools working.

  • Qualify interested creators and arrange calls with Ryan.

  • Onboard creators through account setup, tutorials, Slack, and their first briefs.

  • Answer questions promptly and give clear feedback on video drafts.

  • Check content against briefs, including product visibility, captions, and on-screen text.

  • Track posting schedules, follow up on missed deadlines, and flag blockers early.

  • Use Claude and Claude Code to improve list management, reporting, follow-ups, and other recurring work.

Over time, you may also take on creative-reference research and weekly brief writing.

What we’re looking for

  • You’ve created and published short-form videos yourself and can show us your work.

  • You have experience managing creators or influencer campaigns.

  • You can coordinate 20+ creator relationships and keep accurate records.

  • You understand short-form content and can explain how a video could be better.

  • You communicate clearly, stay friendly when following up, and take responsibility for getting things finished.

  • You use AI tools regularly and check their output carefully.

A strong presence on X, familiarity with Trybe or SideShift, and an academic or research background are all useful extras.

How to apply

No resume needed. Email ryan at answerthis dot io with the subject UGC Manager and include:

  1. Your Instagram or TikTok.

  2. A creator program you’ve managed, including its size, what you personally owned, and the results.

  3. Something you’ve automated with AI and what it improved.

  4. Your location, availability, and earliest start date.
